name: Nasu Kayo
source:
Name: Hanayo Nasu (in [I]AI[/I] and [I]AINI[/I] Present) | Hanayo Yogano ([I]AINI[/I] Past)
Sex: Female
Age: 36 (in [I]AI[/I] (falsely listed as 24) and [I]AINI[/I] Past) | 42 (in [I]AINI[/I] Present)
Birthday: April 27
Profession: Nurse
Likes: Candles, Ropes, Rodeos ([I]AI[/I]) | Tengu, Matsutake, Zucchini ([I]AINI[/I] Past) | Manual Transmissions ([I]AINI[/I] Present)
Dislikes: Jocks, Queen Bees ([I]AI[/I]) | Dirty Talk, Perverts, Shameless People ([I]AINI[/I] Past) | Speed Traps, Traffic Cams ([I]AINI[/I] Present)
Hobbies: Theater ([I]AI[/I], [I]AINI[/I] Past) | Driving ([I]AINI[/I] Present)
Skills: Can shave really fast ([I]AI[/I], [I]AINI[/I] Past) | Drifting, Double-Clutching ([I]AINI[/I] Present)

In [i][url=/v26532]AI: The Somnium Files[/url][/i]:
She is a member of a small group of actor/nurses. She practices hard, even though she has yet to land a leading role.

In [i][url=/v31469]AI: The Somnium Files - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/I]:
[Past]
It may have said her was 24 somewhere before, but that was in base 16. In base 10, her actual age is 36. That's her actual age. She's in a theater group.
[Present]
Her actual age is 42. She took care of [url=/c110381]Jin Furue[/url] when he was in his late teens. Recently, she got into cars and goes on expressway races when she's off the clock. She's still in the theater group.

[From the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]In the first game, Hanayo attends to [url=/c86552]Saito Sejima[/url] as his nurse after he gets in a car accident inside [url=/c86028]Renju Okiura[/url]'s body. In the second game, she attends to [url=/c112133]Bibi[/url] in the Past and to [url=/c103300]Ryuki[/url] in the Present.
In the first game, she is engaged with [url=/c86544]Dokuta Yogano[/url], a mob doctor working for the Kumakuras. In the second game, she is seemingly already married to Dokuta in the Past, but in the Present the two are divorced[/spoiler]
